<style>
  .quarto-title-block {

  .recruiter-page {

  }

  .recruiter-shell {

    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 1rem;
  }

  .recruiter-label,
  .recruiter-card-label,
  .recruiter-stat-label,
  .recruiter-section-label {
    display: inline-flex;

    gap: 0.55rem;

    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  }

  .recruiter-label::before,
  .recruiter-card-label::before,
  .recruiter-stat-label::before,
  .recruiter-section-label::before {
    content: "";

    height: 1px;
    background: rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.4);
  }

  .recruiter-hero {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 290px) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.8rem);
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.18);
    border-radius: 2rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.13) 0%,
        rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0) 42%
      ),
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(var(--bs-secondary-bg-rgb), 0.94) 0%,
        rgba(var(--bs-body-bg-rgb), 0.98) 100%
      );
    box-shadow: 0 28px 72px rgba(17, 45, 78, 0.12);
  }

  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .recruiter-hero {
    box-shadow: 0 28px 72px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32);
  }

  .recruiter-hero::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-emphasis-color-rgb), 0.06);
    border-radius: 1.4rem;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .recruiter-photo-frame {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.16);
    border-radius: 1.6rem;
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        160deg,
        rgba(var(--bs-body-bg-rgb), 0.68) 0%,
        rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.1) 100%
      );
  }

  .recruiter-photo-frame::before {
    content: "Candidate profile";
    position: absolute;
    top: 1rem;
    left: 1rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--bs-emphasis-color);
    background: rgba(var(--bs-body-bg-rgb), 0.75);
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.15);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }

  .recruiter-photo-frame img {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 1.2rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-emphasis-color-rgb), 0.08);
    box-shadow: 0 22px 40px rgba(17, 45, 78, 0.18);

  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .recruiter-photo-frame img {
    box-shadow: 0 22px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);

  .recruiter-copy {
    position: relative;

    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  .recruiter-copy h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);

    letter-spacing: -0.04em;

  .recruiter-kicker {
    max-width: 12ch;

    max-width: 62ch;

  }

  .recruiter-hero-links .btn {
    min-width: 13rem;
  }

  .recruiter-highlights {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-top: 1.4rem;
  }

  .recruiter-stat {
    padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-border-color-rgb), 0.8);

      linear-gradient(

      );

  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .recruiter-stat {
    box-shadow: 0 18px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  }

  .recruiter-stat-value {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 0.75rem;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--bs-emphasis-color);
  }

  .recruiter-section {
    margin-top: 2.1rem;
  }

  .recruiter-section h2 {
    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
    font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3vw, 2.6rem);
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }

  .recruiter-section > p {
    max-width: 62ch;
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  }

  .recruiter-actions-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-top: 1.2rem;
  }

  .recruiter-action-card {
    height: 100%;
    padding: 1.35rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-border-color-rgb), 0.8);
    border-radius: 1.55rem;

      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(var(--bs-secondary-bg-rgb), 0.96) 0%,

      );

    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  }

    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);

  .recruiter-action-card .btn,

  }

    display: grid;

  }

    display: grid;

  }

  .recruiter-faq-nav .nav-link {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.95rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-border-color-rgb), 0.85);
    border-radius: 1.1rem;
    text-align: left;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--bs-emphasis-color);
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(var(--bs-secondary-bg-rgb), 0.92) 0%,
        rgba(var(--bs-body-bg-rgb), 0.95) 100%
      );
  }

  .recruiter-faq-nav .nav-link.active {
    color: var(--bs-primary);

      );

  }

  .recruiter-faq-panel {
    padding: 1.35rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-border-color-rgb), 0.8);
    border-radius: 1.55rem;
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(var(--bs-secondary-bg-rgb), 0.98) 0%,
        rgba(var(--bs-body-bg-rgb), 0.98) 100%
      );

    box-shadow: 0 22px 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);

    gap: 0.5rem;

  .recruiter-accordion .accordion-item {
    margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(var(--bs-border-color-rgb), 0.82);

  .recruiter-accordion .accordion-button {
    padding: 1rem 1.1rem;

## Recruiter essentials

Calendly slot if you want to assess fit live.

### Short resume

The concise version for intake screens, shortlists, and quick internal
circulation.

:::

::: {.recruiter-action-card}
<span class="recruiter-card-label">02 / Full CV</span>

full CV is ready to replace it.

<script
  src="https://assets.calendly.com/assets/external/widget.js"
  type="text/javascript"
  async
></script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".recruiter-calendly-trigger").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const url = button.dataset.calendlyUrl;

        if (url && window.Calendly) {
          window.Calendly.initPopupWidget({ url });
        } else if (url) {
          window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
        }
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-accordion-action]").forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const accordion = document.getElementById(
          button.dataset.accordionTarget,
        );
        const action = button.dataset.accordionAction;

        if (!accordion || !window.bootstrap) {
          return;
        }

        accordion.querySelectorAll(".accordion-collapse").forEach((panel) => {
          const instance = window.bootstrap.Collapse.getOrCreateInstance(panel, {
            toggle: false,
          });

          if (action === "expand") {
            instance.show();
          } else {
            instance.hide();
          }
        });
      });
    });
  });
</script>
